records.description: Cubik.one is a tool free modular cube system for furniture, planters, displays, and custom spaces. Use the online 3D builder to model or AI generate ideas from text or voice, then order the cubes, assemble fast, rebuild anytime, and reuse them again and again.

records.name: Recosint | 14 Free OSINT Tools
records.tagline: 14 free OSINT tools - IP lookup, EXIF, DNS & more
records.description: Free browser-based OSINT and cybersecurity tools - no login required, no software to install. 🔍 IP Intelligence — geolocation, ASN & threat score 👤 Username Search — 45+ platforms + Google Dorks 🌐 DNS Lookup — SPF, DMARC/DKIM analysis 📧 Email Security — spoofing simulator included 🖥️ Browser Fingerprint — WebRTC leak detection 📷 EXIF Analyzer — GPS & device fingerprint + 8 more tools Built for security researchers, investigators and privacy professionals.

records.name: Thimin - Your voice-first private mentor
records.tagline: The judgment-free space for your 'too much' thoughts.
records.description: Stop doomscrolling your own thoughts. Thimin is the voice-first mentor that actually listens. No performance, no judgment, and no data mining. Just a private place to clear your head and figure out your next move"

records.name: GoodPage — Text to Beautiful Page
records.tagline: Convert plain text into stunning, shareable pages in seconds
records.description: GoodPage instantly transforms any plain text into a beautiful, shareable webpage—in just 20 seconds. No design skills needed. Choose from stunning templates, and share a link instead of a file. Perfect for quick proposals, meeting notes, resumes, and social content. It’s the fastest way to make your text look professional. Completely free. Try it now: https://goodpage.net

records.name: Telegraph
records.tagline: Build and deploy Telegram bots without coding
records.description: Telegraph removes the need to set up and host Telegram bots manually. Instead of writing boilerplate code and managing deployments, you can create, configure, and run bots from a single dashboard with built-in hosting and webhook handling. It also supports reusable templates and manages multiple bots in one place, reducing setup time significantly.

records.name: Elytro Agent Wallet
records.tagline: Self-custodial wallet built for AI agents
records.description: Elytro is a self-custodial wallet built for AI agents. Agents can create wallets, simulate and send transactions, swap tokens, and automate payments — without ever holding your private keys. Built-in policies like spending limits, email 2FA, and social recovery keep funds secure while letting agents operate autonomously.

records.name: QA Crow
records.tagline: A murder of crows for your bug backlog
records.description: Write QA tests in plain English. Like, “click the thing, don’t crash.” QACrow reads your plan, fixes your questionable life choices, runs real browser tests, and hands you bugs that actually make sense. No enterprise contracts. No “book a demo.” No sales guy named Chad. Just you, your app, and a very judgmental AI crow making sure it doesn’t break in production. Built for people who ship.

records.name: Quadron AI
records.tagline: Quadron AI
records.description: 1) Code/ Mode with "Debug" button in code box itself debugging full code in single click 2) Money-Free Premium/Plus plans 3) Wikipedia Knowledge In Explore Mode 4) Voice Mode 5) Uses LLM 6) Super Fast AI Reply Speed

records.name: MeruBot
records.tagline: Your AI Interviewer
records.description: - Web based Platform for conducting AI interviews - Generate or upload Job Description - Upload Candidate resume for the Job - AI ranks all the candidates - One or multiple candidates can be invited (email lin) - AI dynamically asks questions by analyzing JD and Resume - Evalution Report is generated - Anti-Cheating mechanism - Privacy and Security compliant Platform

records.name: MeruDesk
records.tagline: Your End-To-End Recruitment Lifecycle Platform
records.description: - Admin Panel, User Management, RBAC, Platform Preferences - Hiring Manager submits requisition, Manager Approves - Auto-Fetch candidate resumes from Company's Career email to the platform - Interview Panel (Human or AI (MeruBot)) can be assigned as required - Integration with MS Teams, Google Meet, Zoom - Interview Panel can submit their feedback once the interview is conducted. - Candidate can be Offered once the final status is 'Selected' - Privacy and Security compliant Platform

records.name: The Craic
records.tagline: What's the Craic? The app that gets you off apps and into...
records.description: The Craic is designed to get people off their chairs, and phones, to meet new people again, in real life, in real time...in the real world. Back to basics baby! You can use the app to find where your types of people are, where the good or busy bars are or where everyone is watching the game. The Craic guides you to the best places and the people you'd like to know, or just simply let's you meet that other person, sitting nearby in the same café, that's also looking to say hi to someone new.

records.name: the roll
records.tagline: a shared camera roll for groups with next day reveal 🎞️
records.description: Most photo apps let everyone see everything instantly. The Roll doesn't. Start a roll, invite your crew, and everyone shoots - but all photos are locked. Then, the next day and at the same moment, every photo is revealed at once. No cherry-picking. No deleting. Just your night, unfiltered. It's the disposable camera experience, rebuilt for groups.

records.name: WhatABot 2.0
records.tagline: Enterprise Automation. Without the Enterprise Fee.
records.description: WhatABot is a fully integrated WhatsApp AI automation platform that gives any business a 24/7 AI employee, handling customer queries, taking orders, confirming shipments, qualifying leads, and running campaigns automatically. Powered by WhatALink, our proprietary connection technology, WhatABot eliminates Meta API fees and complex verification processes entirely. No code. Live in 60 seconds. Enterprise-grade automation for every business, regardless of size or budget.

records.name: Rectangle Shopping + Kits
records.tagline: Shop Across the Internet with One Cart, One Checkout
records.description: Rectangle helps you shop for tech and electronics smarter - from power tools and dishwashers to GPUs, laptops and coffee machines and everything in between. Compare products across retailers, explore better alternatives, and make confident decisions with AI-guided insights. Shop with one cart and check out effortlessly across stores. Kits turns “what should I buy?” into a clear list. Pick a kit that matches how you work or play; we help you fill each slot with compatible, well-matched picks.

records.name: Color Extractly Design Token Studio
records.tagline: Auto‑generate or tailor your design tokens with precision
records.description: A free‑to‑use Figma plugin to create instant design‑system tokens, including powerful utilities to extract tokens from text, code, images, or directly from Figma, or to guide you in building a unique system from scratch.

records.name: Linxly
records.tagline: Short links, deep links, and bio pages in one place
records.description: Linxly is an all-in-one platform for branded short links, deep links, and bio pages with built-in analytics. Custom URLs, QR codes, device-based routing, and real-time click tracking in one dashboard.

records.name: Iqana
records.tagline: Step into the future of digital asset investing
records.description: Iqana offers non-custodial, automated crypto portfolio management with institutional-grade tech and systematic risk management. Targets family offices, HNWIs, and wealth managers.

records.name: DevCodex for Salesforce
records.tagline: Free Salesforce dev utilities — SOQL, Apex, ERD, schedule
records.description: Every Salesforce developer wastes hours a week re-reading the same docs: CRON syntax, Apex wrapper boilerplate, permission diffs, SOQL relationship patterns. This toolkit collects six focused web utilities that eliminate that tax — all free, no signup.

records.name: Knowzilla
records.tagline: Real-time AI for sales that guides every deal
records.description: Knowzilla gives sales teams real-time answers during live calls, so they can handle tough questions, overcome objections, and stop losing deals because the answer was buried in a playbook.

records.name: Landler by The Landbanking Group
records.tagline: The operating system for natural capital management
records.description: The economic value of nature becomes, finally, financially recognised. Landler is the operating system for managing natural capital. Built by The Landbanking Group, it combines satellite data, ecological science, and AI to make the environmental condition of any piece of land measurable, comparable, and investable. Companies use it to manage physical nature risk in their supply chains, land stewards get rewarded for regeneration, and investors get verified proof of ecological outcomes.

records.name: Sendr
records.tagline: Send money like a Text Message. Powered by Stablecoins.
records.description: Building stablecoin-native cross-border financial rails for immigrants, freelancers, global workforce and businesses. You send dollars, recipients receive pesos, rupees, and more. The stablecoin layer is invisible. What Sendr offers: 🏦 Virtual USD & EUR accounts — in your name, no new bank needed 🔄 Fiat → stablecoins → fiat — invisible stablecoin rails, zero complexity. 🦊 Send money internationally from MetaMask & Phantom directly. ⚡️ Global delivery in minutes.

records.name: Put It Back: Focus Coach
records.tagline: Your phone roasts you when you break focus
records.description: Put It Back is a focus coach with attitude. Start a 15, 25, or 45 minute session, place your phone face-down, and get back to work. If you pick it up too soon, your chosen coach — Mom, the Sergeant, or the Therapist — immediately calls you out. It uses motion and shake detection, tracks streaks and pickups, shows progress on the Lock Screen, and works fully on-device with no account required. It turns focus into a game of not getting caught slipping.
